verdict.rationale: Runpod documents SSH access to Pods for command-line access and "full shell capabilities", and lets users run custom containers from any registry, so the core SSH path is clearly there. However, the evidence never mentions bringing your own SSH keys or granting root-level control. Community reports describe the execution environment as "very locked down" (containerized), which tempers how much control a user really gets. Missing for 10: documentation of user-supplied SSH public keys, explicit root/sudo access, independent hands-on confirmation of full environment control.
